verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only AI help built into the documentation and llms.txt/llms-full.txt files that give AI tools context on the docs. These help developers read the docs or build their own integrations. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party way to operate Paxos itself (trades, transfers, onboarding) through natural-language commands, such as an in-product assistant or agent interface. Adjacent docs-help features and developer building blocks earn no credit.
